demoNotice: Demonstration document. No certified legal or tax compliance.
demoShort: Simple rules, to adapt to your country.
welcomeBody: Your customers, invoices and journal entries in one workspace.
loginHelp: Sign in with the account created by your administrator.
emptyHint: Create your first item or adjust the filters.
name: Name
customersIntro: Good relationships start with up-to-date information.
productsIntro: Your products and services, ready to invoice.
invoicesIntro: From the first draft to the final payment, keep track.
serverTotals: Amounts are calculated by the server when saved.
validationNotice: Validation assigns a number and creates journal entries. The invoice becomes final.
immutableNotice: Validated invoice: details and amounts are frozen. Credit notes and refunds are outside this version.
paymentNotice: Manual recording only. No bank transfer is executed.
selectionRequired: Select a result from the list.
invoiceSaved: Draft saved. Totals are up to date.
invoiceValidated: Invoice validated and journal entries created.
accountingIntro: Posted entries, directly from your business activity.
balanceHelp: Select a period to view posted movements.
localeHelp: Regional format and currency are independent of language.
accessHelp: The server enforces permissions for every operation.
rounding: Net prices · HALF_UP rounding per line · precision: {precision}
error_generic: The operation failed. Your input has been preserved.
error_invalid_input: Check the entered fields, dates and values.
error_invalid_credentials: Unable to sign in. Check your credentials.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error_permission_denied: Your role does not allow this operation.
error_not_authenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
error_not_found: This item could not be found.
error_csrf_failed: The session needs refreshing. Preserve your input, then reload the page.
error_immutable: A validated invoice or entry cannot be changed.
error_period_closed: This date belongs to a closed period.
error_period_missing: No open period covers this date. Contact your administrator.
error_invalid_amount: Enter a valid, strictly positive decimal amount.
error_overpayment: The payment exceeds the outstanding balance. Refresh the invoice.
error_idempotency_required: The operation key is missing. Try again from this form.
error_idempotency_conflict: This operation was already sent with different content.
error_already_validated: This invoice has already been validated. Refresh the page.
error_archived_reference: The selected customer or item is archived.
error_configuration_locked: Currency and precision are locked after the first validation.
error_network_error: Connection to the server was interrupted. Your input is preserved; you can retry.
error_server_error: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
priceListIntro: View your prices and filter catalogue items.
imageUrlHelp: HTTPS address of a hosted image.
quickSearch: Search items by name or code
companyCurrencyHelp: Prices use the company currency, without conversion.
catalogIntro: Manage categories, warehouses and units for your products.
noStockTracking: Warehouses classify products. Stock quantities are not tracked.
purchasePriceHelp: Leave blank if the purchase price is unknown.
partnerCreditLimitHelp: This reference does not automatically block invoices. Leave blank if undefined.
partnerCustomFieldsHelp: Up to 20 text fields: names up to 60 characters and values up to 500 characters.
partnerPricesHelp: One net price per product and customer. The customer’s default discount still applies when preparing an invoice.
partnerStatementHelp: Validated invoices issued in the selected period, including payments to date. Totals cover all pages; printing includes the displayed page.
printStudioIntro: Customize future documents and preview their layout.
printFrozenNotice: These options are frozen when future invoices are validated. Existing validated invoices keep their original appearance.
printSampleNotice: LAYOUT SAMPLE — fictional data, no accounting value
draftPrintNotice: DRAFT — unvalidated document, no final number
customerPricingNotice: Customer pricing applies to products added after selecting the customer. Changing customers preserves existing line prices and discounts.
duplicateInvoiceNotice: Choose dates for the new draft. Lines and options are copied without a number, payment or accounting entry.
integrationIntro: Connect your website or application with access limited to your company.
integrationManualNotice: Providers are registered manually. No external provider is connected yet. API invoices remain drafts; received transactions do not create payments.
keyOneTime: This key is shown once. Copy it into your application's secret manager before closing this panel.
apiExplorerHelp: These examples do not execute requests. Replace placeholders in your server application. A distinct idempotency key is required for each write operation.
bankingIntro: Import statements and reconcile receipts with invoices.
bankManualNotice: CSV import and manual reconciliation. No bank is connected live and no transfers are sent. The displayed total covers imported rows, not the actual bank balance.
bankCsvHelp: UTF-8, comma separator, maximum 500 rows and 250 KB. Columns: external_id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), amount (signed decimal with a dot), description; optional reference. IDs must be unique per account.
bankImported: Statement imported. Payments still need reconciliation.
bankReconcileHelp: Select a validated invoice. Confirmation records a payment for the exact bank-row amount and its accounting entry. The amount must be positive and not exceed the balance due.
bankReconcileConfirm: I confirm allocating this receipt to the selected invoice.
externalReceivedHelp: These records come from your API-authorized applications. They do not prove receipt of funds and create no accounting payment. Check them against your bank statement.
error_connectionCopyFailed: Automatic copy unavailable. Select and copy the key in the field.
dashboardIntro: Your company’s sales, receipts and due dates.
exportsIntro: Download your company’s filtered data as CSV.
exportHelp: Up to 5,000 rows per export. Narrow the period or search if needed.
error_export_limit: Too many results: narrow your filters to export up to 5,000 rows.
billingIntro: Manage your company’s access to Azula and your subscription.
billingDisabled: Azula access is open. A paid subscription is not currently required.
billingExempt: Your company has access without a paid subscription.
billingAccessRequired: An active subscription is required to access ERP modules. Your data is retained.
billingAccessActive: Your company can access the ERP modules.
billingCancellationScheduled: Cancellation is scheduled at the end of the period. Manage it in the billing portal.
billingPortalHelp: The secure portal lets you manage payments, subscription invoices and cancellation.
billingNotConfigured: Subscriptions are not available yet. Contact the Azula team to activate them.
billingAdminOnly: Only a company administrator can purchase or manage the subscription.
billingPending: A payment is being prepared or confirmed. Refresh the status after using the payment page.
billingTrialRenewal: After the {days}-day trial, the subscription automatically renews at {price} {interval}, unless canceled before the trial ends. The final amount is shown on the payment page.
billingRenewal: The subscription automatically renews at {price} {interval} until canceled through the portal. The final amount is shown on the payment page.
billingConsent: I have reviewed the selected subscription’s price, billing frequency and automatic renewal.
billingCheckoutHelp: You will confirm your subscription on Stripe’s secure page. Azula does not collect your card number.
billingReturnSuccess: You have returned from the payment page. Only server confirmation of payment activates access. Refresh the status if confirmation is still pending.
billingReturnCancelled: You left the payment page. This return alone does not activate new access.
error_subscription_required: An active subscription is required to use Azula.
error_billing_invalid_redirect: The payment page received is invalid. Try again or contact the Azula team.
error_billing_not_configured: Subscription payments are not configured yet.
error_billing_provider_unavailable: The payment service is temporarily unavailable. Try again with the same plan.
error_billing_checkout_pending: A payment is already in progress. Resume it or refresh its status.
error_billing_subscription_exists: A subscription already exists. Manage it through the portal.
error_billing_invalid_plan: This plan is no longer available. Refresh the plans.
error_billing_unavailable: The payment service is temporarily unavailable. Try again with the same plan.
error_billing_use_portal: A subscription already exists. Manage it through the portal.
error_billing_checkout_finished: This payment is complete or expired. Refresh the status before trying again.
error_billing_no_subscription: No subscription was found to manage. Refresh the status.
error_billing_idempotency_required: The payment request is incomplete. Reload the page before trying again.
error_billing_invalid_event: The payment confirmation received is invalid. Refresh the status or contact the Azula team.
error_billing_subscription_conflict: The subscription changed during this operation. Refresh the status before trying again.
error_billing_mode_conflict: The payment configuration is incompatible with this subscription. Contact the Azula team.
